title: Cards show real play time (web skins) instead of a permanent empty slot
description: SkinWebGridEntry.hours shipped nil forever; now every skin's card shows locally recorded play time next to the genre ('12.5 h'), in a quiet .ptime span that inherits the skin's subdued color. Empty for never-played games - no fake '0 h' noise.
commit_message: Show real play time on grid cards
author: prepare-chain:claude
